title: ReviewResult
description: A review-result artifact, read for its findings.

engineering.description: The store the review is recorded in (the `--engineering` the command resolved).

findings_block.description: The body carries a `findings` block, an empty `[]` one included: findings.rs:618-633 (`recorded`) answers `Some`; a body with no block (`None`) is `false`.

prose_only.description: Why this review records its findings as prose only, as `--prose-only <reason>` gave it. Present only on a review with no block.

created_at.description: When the review was recorded, dated the way `validate` dates a review it asks for an outcome (planning.rs `reviews_recorded_at`, read by `reviews_without_an_outcome` and the findings rule alike): the creation entry of an SQLite or Postgres store's history; in a Git-native store inside a Git work tree, the commit that added the file (planning/git_record.rs `first_committed`), or now when the file is not committed yet. Undated (absent) when the store holds no creation entry for it; when the repository is a shallow clone and the commit that added the file is a shallow boundary commit (one `git rev-parse --git-path shallow` lists), whose history does not reach the real one; and when the store is not in a Git work tree that versions it (a `git archive` export, a copied or ignored directory). An undated review is never created before the opt-in, and is never reported overdue for an outcome. A review `new` writes carries no transition, so its first transition cannot date it.

superseded_by_block.description: Another review-result whose body carries a `findings` block names this one with a `supersedes` edge (planning.rs:7865; story acceptance 5). Pinned by `a_review_without_a_block_superseded_by_a_review_with_a_block_is_exempt_and_listed` and `a_supersedes_edge_from_a_review_without_a_block_does_not_exempt` (aep-cli validate tests).

created_before_opt_in.description: The store sets `findings_required_since` and `created_at` is defined and before the start of that date in UTC; `false` when the key is absent or the review is undated. Pinned by `a_review_without_a_block_created_before_the_opt_in_is_exempt_and_listed`, `a_review_created_at_midnight_utc_of_the_opt_in_date_is_not_exempt`, `a_store_outside_git_dates_no_review_and_names_the_repository_as_the_remedy` (aep-cli validate tests) and `a_shallow_clone_leaves_a_review_in_its_boundary_commit_undated_and_names_the_full_history` (aep-cli findings_required_adversary).

store_requires_findings.description: The project file of the store this review is recorded in sets `findings_required_since` (project.rs:650-702, `RawProjectConfig`, with the change).
